entities.name: PMID:25093845
observations: 2014 PLOS ONE study of peripheral blood mononuclear cells in young healthy smokers and nonsmokers.
Smoking cessation was assessed after 1 month using γ-H2AX foci as a DSB marker.

entities.name: MNC γH2AX reversal
observations: In 15 active smokers, median γ-H2AX foci were 4.44/cell (IQR 4.36–5.24) before cessation and 0.28/cell (IQR 0.12–0.53) after 1 month; p<0.05.

The post-cessation level was comparable to 12 nonsmokers (median 0.37/cell, IQR 0.31–0.58). This demonstrates reversal of the measured population-level DSB signal, not necessarily repair tracking of each pre-existing break.
